name: Group Up Industrial Co., Ltd.
summary: Established in 1990 and based in Taoyuan City, Taiwan, Group Up Industrial Co., Ltd. operates as both a manufacturer and global distributor of various general-purpose, box-shaped industrial equipment. The company's market reach extends across Taiwan, China, and international territories. Its product portfolio is extensive, featuring diverse oven technologies such as hot air, vacuum, infrared (IR) drying, hot plate conveyor, and automated conveyor ovens. Additionally, Group Up supplies specialized machinery including UV curing, coating, exposure, and levelling machines, alongside comprehensive line integration solutions. A significant portion of its expertise lies in roll-to-roll systems, offering solutions for drying, laminating, exposure, coating, printing, and hot pressing. The company also provides advanced robotic baking systems. These sophisticated products and services cater to a broad spectrum of high-technology sectors, including the manufacturing of printed circuit boards (PCB), BGA, flexible printed circuits (FPC), COF, display technologies, touch panels, backlights, solar cells, smart cards, optical films, batteries, and semiconductors.
